decisions.thought: Mirror team. Lead Garchomp with Focus Sash guarantees Stealth Rock up, and Scale Shot/Earthquake pressure their Garchomp. Gholdengo blocks status and covers Fairy/Dragon, Kingambit provides late-game power.

Garchomp mirror: my Earthquake hits hard and I'm likely faster or at worst speed-tied. Even if they outspeed and KO, my Focus Sash guarantees I survive and get rocks or another hit up next turn. Dealing damage now is better than passively setting rocks.

decisions.thought: My Earthquake took Sylveon from 100% to 38% last turn, so a second EQ easily KOs it before it can move (I'm faster). Finishing it now is better than setting rocks or switching.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Sylveon at 44%, EQ likely KOs? Turn 1 EQ took it from 100 to 38, then healed to 44. So EQ does ~62%, another EQ KOs.

decisions.thought: Mirror Garchomp matchup; mine may or may not be faster. Earthquake only 3HKOs at best, so setting Stealth Rock while they likely Earthquake is fine—my Focus Sash keeps me safe. Rocks add long-term value.
Their Garchomp has +1 speed and just Scale Shot; Kingambit resists Dragon but fears Earthquake. Gholdengo is immune to EQ and takes neutral Scale Shot, and outspeeds even at +1 to threaten it.

Garchomp is faster, but its Defense is at -1 and Make It Rain gets STAB plus Life Orb, which should knock it out even if it hits me first with Scale Shot. Gholdengo isn't weak to Scale Shot, so it survives the hit. Taking the KO now is better than setting up and risking damage.

Gholdengo vs Garchomp: Make It Rain is Steel, resisted by Garchomp (Ground/Dragon resists? Steel is not resisted by Ground/Dragon — Ground neutral, Dragon neutral, so neutral). 120 BP Life Orb vs Garchomp with -1 Def... Garchomp is faster (+1 speed after Scale Shot, 163-253 range, likely faster). Garchomp likely OHKOs or heavily damages Gholdengo with Earthquake? Gholdengo isn't weak to EQ. Make It Rain: 120 BP neutral with Life Orb 1.3x = ~156 effective vs Garchomp with -1 Def. Garchomp HP 183-215. Gholdengo SpA 185. 120 BP neutral STAB? Gholdengo is Steel/Ghost, Make It Rain is Steel = STAB 1.5. So 120*1.5*1.3 = 234 effective vs -1 Def Garchomp. Likely OHKO. Garchomp at 100%, -1 Def. That should KO. But Garchomp moves first — can it KO Gholdengo first? Scale Shot 4 hits last time vs 183 HP Garchomp... wait that was our Garchomp. Opposing Scale Shot vs Gholdengo: 25 BP, Dragon, neutral, +1 Atk, up to 5 hits. Gholdengo Def 115. Probably doesn't OHKO. So Make It Rain likely KOs before taking lethal damage. Best: Make It Rain.
